method: Phaser camera intersection plus visible parent chain; DOM visibility plus CSS frame sampling. No loading/registry presence counted as rendered.

checks: Door opens by input, pauses its clock, expires, waits for player clearance, closes and resets.
Contact platform drops its rider after the delay, returns after hidden interval and resets.
Bounce launches the real player upward and resets; element stays Earth.
Floating block falls into water, reaches its draft and carries Earth with the current, without a water retry.
Active barrier blocks real movement; switch off removes collision and restart restores it.
Activate / deactivate / toggle switches command two mechanism IDs using normal input.
Wrong element is ignored; a real Fire gem pickup and projectile activate the configured switch.
Invalid optional sheets use original static fallback art while door timing and collision remain functional.
All six functional palette entries expose their gameplay parameters and ID links.
Explicit save and reopen preserve every parameter and connection in JSON v1.
Playtest mounts, pauses, resumes, resizes, restarts and unmounts without modifying the draft or campaign save.
Lever input activates elevator; the real player rides upward
Restart restores lift and lever state
Horizontal fan blocks Water, Fire and Air; Earth moves against it
Matching elements traverse liquid surfaces; wrong elements restart the attempt
Actual Water shots activate the wheel; Fire cannot
Boiler receives Water, then Fire after an actual gem pickup; no manual transformation
Earth timed strike destroys wall after configured hits and removes collision
Lever extends and retracts bridge; collision follows completed extension
Actual menu/options/levels/HUD/pause/resume/restart/mobile landscape/unmount
Real portal completion opens RunHud reward animation; every CSS frame sampled
Lever drives door opening/closing and fan starting/stopping through real ability input
World coin spin and pickup burst; pickup does not mint saved currency
Actual Water/Fire projectiles activate tank water loop and torch flame
Heating plays without activating steam prematurely; real gem replacement and Water hit enable steam
Four gem colors spawn, idle and collect; each transforms immediately, with independent VFX
Representative full wheel loop, elemental projectiles, jumps, Fire double jump, Air glide and Earth landing
Pause freezes scene; repeated restart keeps textures, object count and physics listeners bounded
